Name: Dr. Stone Senku Ishigami Hair
Author: Undata
Description:
Play as you favorite scientist!

A very simple mod that puts Senku Ishigami's hairstyle (Dr. STONE) into the game.

You can get it either as a replacer, (replaces default hairstyle no. 9),
or compatible with Fashion Sense (FS), courtesy of the very kind and helpful [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/74912973]Novaphene[/url]!

Enjoy!

Downloads.Description: Replaces default hair no. 9 with Senku Ishigami's hair.

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).

Downloads.Description: Big thanks to Novaphene (https://www.nexusmods.com/users/74912973) for converting this hair to be usable with Fashion Sense!
